name: Ruff and Honours
description: Ruff and Honours was a 17th-century English ancestor of Whist. Trick-taking with trump and honours. Reconstructions at WAKS Medieval Games, TrapApps online.

content.text: Ruff and Honours was a 17th-century English ancestor of Whist. Trick-taking with trump and honours. Reconstructions at WAKS Medieval Games, TrapApps online.

17th-century England. Whist ancestor.
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4 (two partnerships of two)
Partnerships: Yes; partners sit opposite

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space
Twelve cards per player, dealt four at a time clockwise. Four cards remain as stock; top card turned for trump.

items.text: Ruff and Trump: Closely related game per Willughby; similar rules with minor differences in reconstruction.
Honours declaration: Optional scoring: declare three or more honours, or Can-ye with two to count partner's honours; except on eight points declaration ends the deal.
